Interface Graph

All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<String>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractGraph, AdjacencyListGraph
public interface Graph extends Iterable<String>
A directed graph with string-labeled vertices and directed edges.

    • read

      static Graph read(Path path) throws IOException
      Reads a graph from a file in the graph text format. The returned graph uses the default adjacency-list representation.
      Parameters:
      path - the file to read
      Returns:
      a graph containing the data from the file
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read
      IllegalArgumentException - if the file is malformed
